CustomField.description: Takes this page out of the live form without deleting it: respondents never see it in the form, the navigation or the stages overview. Its sections and conditional logic are kept, and cloning still copies it. Off by default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check this to take the page out of the live form without deleting it; respondents never see it. Its sections and settings are kept, so uncheck it to bring the page back.
CustomField.label: Hide Page
